text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On her day off, Haru Urara walked around 
the shopping street handing out flyers 
made by the fan club, asking people to 
vote for her to run in the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume who ran alongside Haru Urara 
in the February Stakes happens to pass by.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing the flyer urging people to vote, 
she grew angry at Haru Urara for having no 
intention of earning votes through her own 
running, and walked away.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Left behind, Haru Urara realized from her 
words that she couldn't keep going on the 
way she was now.
